name: Pythagoreion and Heraion of Samos
description: On the Greek island of Samos, just off the Turkish coast, lie the ruins of the ancient fortified port of Pythagoreion and the nearby Heraion, a vast sanctuary of the goddess Hera. At the Heraion, one lone column still stands from a giant Ionic temple, among the first of its kind. Pythagoreion's highlight is a tunnel-aqueduct cut through a mountain.
